title: Soup for the Crew
lines: A group of kids made soup at camp.
Sam threw in beans, corn and nuts.
But the soup was blue! Why was that?
Tom held up a jug of blue glue.
The crew had to start a new pot.
This soup was good. They ate it all.

questions.ask: What made the soup turn blue?
questions.listenFor: Blue glue that Tom put in by mistake. Line five gives it away.

questions.ask: What did the crew do about the blue soup?
questions.listenFor: They started a new pot. The second soup was good.

questions.ask: What should the crew do with the blue soup? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any sensible answer is fine - tip it out, wash the pot, start again. Listen for the reason: glue is not food.
